01 /The idea

In a world that never stops,
here’s a reason to pause.

Light bends. Colors collide. Something familiar becomes something you’ve never seen before. PRISM is a small space for that feeling — the quiet thrill of simply looking.

For the sake of wonder.

02 / Three states of wonder
